inlines.v: MAN'IFOLD, adjective [many and fold.] Of divers kinds; many in number; numerous; multiplied. O Lord, how manifold are thy works! Psalms 104:24. I know your manifold transgressions. Amos 5:12. 1. Exhibited or appearing at divers times or in various ways; applied to words in the singular number; as the manifold wisdom of God, or his manifold grace. Ephesians 3:10. 1 Peter 4:10.
